note: Usually paired with 都 or 也 in the second clause.

examples.zh: 不论天气怎么样，我们都去。
examples.en: No matter what the weather is like, we're going.

examples.zh: 不论你想吃什么，我都可以。
examples.en: Whatever you want to eat is fine with me.

examples.zh: 不论多忙，他每天都去跑步。
examples.en: However busy he is, he goes running every day.

meaning: a full, whole (amount of time); no less than

senses.en: a full, whole (amount of time); no less than

note: Goes before a time or number: 整整三年.

examples.zh: 我在医院整整等了三个小时。
examples.en: I waited at the hospital for a full three hours.

examples.zh: 他整整一个星期没睡好。
examples.en: He didn't sleep well for a whole week.

examples.zh: 这件事他想了整整一晚上。
examples.en: He thought about this all night long.

examples.zh: 请把药放到桌子上。
examples.en: Please put the medicine on the table.

examples.zh: 你把手机放到包里了吗？
examples.en: Did you put your phone in your bag?

examples.zh: 别把手机放到水里。
examples.en: Don't put your phone in the water.

note: More written than 女人 or 女的; common in news and in 女子 + sport.

examples.zh: 那位女子是我们的老师。
examples.en: That woman is our teacher.

examples.zh: 一名女子在门口等你。
examples.en: A woman is waiting for you at the door.

examples.zh: 这是一场女子足球比赛。
examples.en: This is a women's soccer match.

meaning: to cooperate with; to coordinate; to fit together

senses.en: to cooperate with; to coordinate; to fit together

examples.zh: 谢谢大家的配合。
examples.en: Thank you all for your cooperation.

examples.zh: 医生要求病人配合检查。
examples.en: The doctor asks the patient to cooperate with the exam.

examples.zh: 我们两个人配合得很好。
examples.en: The two of us work together very well.

meaning: to have; to possess (a quality or feature)

senses.en: to have; to possess (a quality or feature)

note: Formal; the object is usually an abstract noun.

examples.zh: 这个办法具有很大的作用。
examples.en: This method is very effective.

examples.zh: 她具有丰富的经验。
examples.en: She has a wealth of experience.

examples.zh: 他具有做老师的能力。
examples.en: He has what it takes to be a teacher.

examples.zh: 山上有很多羊。
examples.en: There are many sheep on the mountain.

examples.zh: 他家养了二十只羊。
examples.en: His family keeps twenty sheep.

examples.zh: 今天晚上我们吃羊肉。
examples.en: Tonight we're having lamb.

note: 真巧 is the everyday way to say "what a coincidence".

examples.zh: 真巧，我也在这儿！
examples.en: What a coincidence, I'm here too!

examples.zh: 你来得巧，我们刚要吃饭。
examples.en: Good timing, we were just about to eat.

examples.zh: 她手很巧，会做很多小东西。
examples.en: She is good with her hands and can make many small things.

meaning: skill and effort; time; kung fu

senses.en: skill and effort; time; kung fu

note: Pronounced gōngfu; 花功夫 means to put in time and effort.

examples.zh: 他学功夫学了五年。
examples.en: He has studied kung fu for five years.

examples.zh: 做这道菜要花很多功夫。
examples.en: This dish takes a lot of effort to make.

examples.zh: 我最近没功夫去看你。
examples.en: I haven't had the time to visit you lately.

examples.zh: 这个句子不完整。
examples.en: This sentence is not complete.

examples.zh: 你能把这件事完整地说一遍吗？
examples.en: Can you tell the whole story from start to finish?

examples.zh: 这个碗很旧，但是还很完整。
examples.en: This bowl is old, but still intact.

examples.zh: 朋友要相互帮助。
examples.en: Friends should help each other.

examples.zh: 我们相互不认识。
examples.en: We don't know each other.

examples.zh: 他们相互看了一眼，笑了。
examples.en: They looked at each other and smiled.

examples.zh: 这个活动需要多宣传。
examples.en: This event needs more publicity.

examples.zh: 商店在网上宣传这个活动。
examples.en: The shop promotes this event online.

examples.zh: 他们的宣传做得很好。
examples.en: Their publicity is very well done.

examples.zh: 两家公司正在谈判。
examples.en: The two companies are negotiating now.

examples.zh: 这次谈判很顺利。
examples.en: The negotiation went smoothly this time.

examples.zh: 我想跟老板谈判工资的事。
examples.en: I want to negotiate my salary with the boss.

examples.zh: 这条街是城市的商业中心。
examples.en: This street is the commercial center of the city.

examples.zh: 他在大学学商业。
examples.en: He studies business at university.

examples.zh: 这里有很多商业活动。
examples.en: There are many commercial events here.

note: Used for packaged or sold food: 食品安全.

examples.zh: 这家超市的食品很便宜。
examples.en: The food at this supermarket is cheap.

examples.zh: 食品要放在冷的地方。
examples.en: Food should be kept somewhere cold.

examples.zh: 孩子吃的食品要注意安全。
examples.en: Food for children needs attention to safety.

meaning: to untie; to undo; to solve (a puzzle)

senses.en: to untie; to undo; to solve (a puzzle)

examples.zh: 这个问题太难，谁也没解开。
examples.en: This problem is so hard that nobody has solved it.

examples.zh: 这道题，我想了很久才解开。
examples.en: I thought a long time before I worked this question out.

examples.zh: 我把包解开，拿出一件衣服。
examples.en: I undid the bag and took out a piece of clothing.

meaning: to hurry to a place and arrive

senses.en: to hurry to a place and arrive

examples.zh: 我十分钟后就能赶到。
examples.en: I can get there in ten minutes.

examples.zh: 他打车赶到机场，飞机还没走。
examples.en: He took a taxi to the airport, and the plane hadn't left yet.

examples.zh: 你几点能赶到医院？
examples.en: What time can you get to the hospital?

examples.zh: 他经营一家小饭馆。
examples.en: He runs a small restaurant.

examples.zh: 这家店经营得不错。
examples.en: This shop is doing quite well.

examples.zh: 你们公司主要经营什么？
examples.en: What does your company mainly deal in?

examples.zh: 这门课程有点儿难。
examples.en: This course is a bit hard.

examples.zh: 我报名了一个汉语课程。
examples.en: I signed up for a Chinese course.

examples.zh: 这个课程每周有两节课。
examples.en: This course has two classes a week.

examples.zh: 他快速地吃完了饭。
examples.en: He finished his meal quickly.

examples.zh: 这个城市快速发展。
examples.en: This city is developing rapidly.

examples.zh: 请快速回答，谢谢。
examples.en: Please answer quickly, thanks.
